about_the_game:
This DLC includes

Phantom Dancer Lorita

Top Star of the Dance Zone | Moonlight Goddess with 3 Million Followers

Lorita, the breathtaking phantom of the dance floor. With her frost-cooled elegance and flame-searing allure, she has captivated millions in the virtual world. Yet, the spotlight’s glory cannot illuminate the harsh reality—even a top-tier dancer’s talent struggles to translate into basic sustenance in an era ruled by clout.

Too proud to grovel for gifts in livestreams, her unyielding spirit refuses to bow to so-called "big spenders." But survival’s pressure is relentless. Finally, Lorita discovers a shadowed path—an obscure app hidden in the depths of the web, a private channel accessible only to "members."

There, the veil of the Moonlight Goddess will be delicately lifted. With riskier, more tantalizing moves, she will guide those who crave a glimpse of her deeper secrets into this forbidden zone of temptation and the unknown... Subscribe now, and step through the taboo gateway into Lorita’s hidden world.
